tools.name: change_sound
tools.description: Change one take of a generation this account made, from the take itself: say what is off in the user's words (change, any language) or name the action. Three versions come back (a light, medium and strong change; for a loop, three seams) as CC0 WAV files. Free: no generation is used and no plan is needed. When the words ask for a different sound rather than a change to this one, it answers no_action with a description to pass to generate_sound. The user should listen and pick one.

order_id.description: The generation, from generate_sound or get_generation

change.description: What is off, in the user's words: 'too muddy', 'make it loop', 'sounds too close'

action.description: crisper: too muddy; heavier: too light; shorter_tail: rings on too long; longer_tail: stops too abruptly; room: too dry; far: too close; loop: make it loop

tools.name: generate_sound
tools.description: Make a new sound effect from a description when the library has nothing suitable (search_sounds has no full match and its closest sounds do not suit; it then returns generate_available). Needs an SFXMint API key and uses the account's 1 free try first, then credits or a plan on the account — a credit pack ($3.90, 10 credits), the 30-day plan ($9.90, 100 credits for 30 days) or the unlimited plan ($19.90 for 30 days, unlimited sounds) — each up to 4 CC0 WAV takes of up to 10 s (with an OGG of each when credits or a plan made it); one that makes no take does not count; with neither it answers payment_required with buy_url and website_url (the website's page where the user can make it and hear it first). Returns CC0 WAV files (signed links valid 15 minutes) with SHA-256 and seed, and ogg_url (Ogg Vorbis, made from the WAV on its first request) for takes made with credits or a plan; if they are not ready within about 25 seconds, it returns the order id for get_generation. AI-generated: the user should listen before use.

prompt.description: The sound the user needs, in plain words and any language: what it is for and what should be heard. With enhance (recommended), SFXMint writes the description the model gets. Leave out lengths (use duration_s).

duration_s.description: Longest length in seconds. Leave it out and SFXMint chooses from the description; either way the silence before and after the sound is cut, so a take can be shorter

variations.description: How many takes to make (default 4; one generation either way)

enhance.description: Recommended: SFXMint writes the prompt into the description the model gets, as the website's AI Enhance does, and the result gives that description. Default false: the prompt goes to the model exactly as written.

variations_of.description: A variation set instead of a new sound: four takes started from one finished take of this account's generation, close to it, for a game to play at random so the sound does not repeat (footsteps, hits, shots). The result adds engine files (a Godot AudioStreamRandomizer .tres and a Unity script) to save beside the WAVs. Uses one generation; prompt then only names the set.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check a generation started with generate_sound or change_sound: status, and fresh download links for the finished takes.

tools.name: get_role_sound
tools.description: Choose this when the task calls for a sound for a named event or interaction — a button click, purchase success, error beep, level-up, dialogue blip, notification. Pass the role as plain words: role ids (click, success, purchase-success, dialogue-blip, notification…) and common aliases (button click, ka-ching, jump scare, text blip…) are all accepted. Returns a qualified candidate for that role when one satisfies the requested constraints, with MP3/WAV URLs, 2-3 alternates and the family page for browsing more. Five core game roles include content_check (verified/unverified/rejected), scoped to scene, role, format and exact file SHA256; unverified previews are not certified suitable. Download selected files locally and retain originals. Task-permitted processing requires a recipe, output SHA256, renewed file checks and a listening check; changed bytes do not inherit content review. Other task-permitted sources or local synthesis may be mixed in. Optional style: crisp (short, bright, dry), soft (darker, gentler), spacious (reverb, longer tail), balanced (default: most typical). For multiple events consider get_sound_set; use search_sounds for a description or a gap. These are task branches, not a fixed sequence. Unknown roles return not_found with the full role list; GET https://sfxmint.com/api/v1/roles lists roles with aliases.

role.description: Role id or alias, e.g. 'click', 'button click', 'purchase-success', 'ka-ching', 'error beep', 'level-up', 'dialogue blip', 'notification'

style.description: Optional. balanced (default) = the family's most typical take; crisp = short, bright, dry; soft = darker, gentler; spacious = reverb, longer tail

max_duration_ms.description: Hard maximum delivered duration in milliseconds.

loop.description: Require prepared loop metadata; seam evidence is returned separately.

tools.name: get_sound
tools.description: Get full metadata for one sound by slug, including download URLs, description and measured acoustics (attack/tail/brightness + character labels).

tools.name: get_sound_set
tools.description: Get a coherent set of sounds for an app or game in one call — one sound per role, with format metadata, hashes and stable download URLs. Use it when the task needs a whole kit; use get_role_sound for one event. Check content_check: verified/unverified/rejected is bound to the exact role, format and file SHA256; unverified files still require listening in context. Sets include UI styles, game and app scenarios, acoustic-drum-kit, animal-calls (15 isolated calls), and dungeon-traps (6 isolated mechanisms).

format.description: File format for selection and checks (default WAV; OGG only among sounds published before 2026-10-14). Legacy urls remains MP3; download_urls follows this format.

set.description: Set id (default ui-crisp). Includes acoustic-drum-kit, animal-calls and dungeon-traps alongside the UI and scenario sets listed in the enum.

tools.name: search_sounds
tools.description: Free-text search over the SFXMint library of free CC0 sound effects. Use it for sound descriptions, additional constraints or gaps left by another tool. Choose get_role_sound for a named event or get_sound_set for multiple events when that fits the task; these are task branches, not a fixed sequence. Hard constraints (duration, loop, format, excluded words) always apply. results hold sounds whose text has every word of the query. When there are none, closest lists the nearest sounds that meet every hard constraint, best first, each with missing_terms: judge them from title and description and let the user listen. library_fit says how well the library covers the request (full, close, weak, none); anything short of full also returns generation options (generate_available; type ambience or bgm when the words ask for a looping ambience or game music, which AI Studio makes on the website). Returns direct, hotlinkable MP3/WAV URLs and verified OGG (Vorbis) URLs where available — no API key, no attribution required — plus measured acoustics (attack_ms, tail_ms, centroid_hz), character labels like 'bright · punchy · tight', loop/file-QC status, and score/match as ranking evidence only (role = known role default, exact = all words hit, partial = some words hit, semantic = nearest by meaning).

query.description: Keywords or a natural-language description, e.g. 'door slam', 'soft UI confirmation chime', 'coin pickup'

category.description: Optional category slug: ui, retro-game, transition, impact, ambience, water, fire-electric, footsteps, door, mechanical, paper-fabric, glass, animal, crowd, cartoon, magic-scifi, horror, feedback, instrument, office, human, vehicle, household

max_duration_ms.description: Hard maximum delivered duration in milliseconds; format-specific measurement is required.

loop.description: Require (true) or exclude (false) a candidate marked with prepared loop metadata; seam evidence is returned separately.

format.description: Delivery format (ogg = Ogg Vorbis, only sounds published before 2026-10-14 have it); loop=true defaults to WAV when omitted.
